fields.statement: QA at 333b5bf65 with a scratch build in a scratch root and repo: run start --foreground of a repo workflow whose command step exits 3 ended failed (exit 1) and then journalled both [[cleanup]] steps (named 'first' and default 'cleanup-2') as pass, in order, after the finished entry; the first ran with pwd = the run worktree and RHIZA_RUN, RHIZA_CHANGE and RHIZA_STEP=first set. A workflow whose step passes with cleanups 'exit 7', an unknown command and a touch ended succeeded (exit 0), logged 'cleanup step breaks failed: exit 7' and 'nonexistent-cmd failed: exit 127' on stderr, journalled both as fail with output tail, and the third still ran (file created). A run held at a wait step (--foreground --no-wait) then run abandon: finished failed 'abandoned by', cleanup 'mark' journalled pass with pwd the worktree, before the worktree was removed; a second abandon is refused and does not rerun it. workflow describe --json of every built-in and repo workflow shows an empty cleanup list.

QA at 333b5bf65 with a scratch build: workflow check passes workflows with valid [[cleanup]] sections and refuses (exit 1) a cleanup with kind = "agent", prompt, on.pass (unknown key "cleanup.kind"/"cleanup.prompt"/"cleanup.on.pass") and name "Bad Name" (want lowercase words). workflow describe prints 'cleanup <name>: <run>' lines in file order and --json carries cleanup [{name, run}], with cleanup-<n> for an unnamed step. docs/reference/workflow-file.md and cli.md document the cleanup key and field. go test ./internal/workflow -run TestParseCleanup and TestScripts/(run-cleanup-steps|workflow-check|workflow-describe) pass.
